triggerReason: The v4.9.0 roadmap moved from external-attestation waiting to the autonomous science program: preregistered hypothesis campaigns, long-horizon dynamics and the season boundary protocol.
action: Implement the hypothesis-campaign framework, preregister and publish two institutional-design campaigns, run a five-simulated-year long-horizon study, and define the season boundary protocol (ADR 0041).
outcome: The campaign framework (nexus.hypothesis-campaign.v1) runs frozen hypotheses over held-out seeds and white-listed civic-policy regimes with exact replay, hashed reports and fail-closed verification. institutional-design-v1 published 2/5 as honest negative evidence (solidarity does not elevate pooled RALR: 0.750086 vs 0.754223; safety instruments saturate at ceiling). institutional-design-v2 published 4/5 (bargain throughput chains efficiency > baseline > solidarity; RALR stable within ±0.01; solidarity's pooled withdrawal rate +0.0064 exceeds the ±0.005 bound and is rejected). The long-horizon study (1,825 Turns x 2 seeds) passed with pooled RALR 0.764811 (5577/7292), zero long-pending episodes and ratification-deceleration drift. The season protocol rolls quarter identifiers deterministically with a hashed archive ledger. No production settlement changed; every denominator, refusal, withdrawal and coercion count remains visible.
evidence: Engine policy injection is white-listed and bounds-clamped
No production settlement, trust lane or evidence contract changed
